name: Aneroid sphygmomanometer
notes: Laid out on a table: cuff roll with tail flap, gauge propped on its stem against the roll, bulb lying front to back, one loose coil behind the bulb.
parts: 2.25 in aneroid gauge: satin steel case, chrome bezel, domed lens
white dial printed 0-300 mmHg, 2 mmHg minor ticks, numerals every 20, zero box
black needle on a chrome hub, rotates about the dial center
adult nylon cuff 53 x 14.5 cm loosely rolled, spiral ends visible, tail flap on the table
two black PVC tubes from the cuff edge, one coiled loop
black rubber inflation bulb, pear shaped, 55 mm
chrome air-release valve with knurled thumbscrew, inlet valve cap
style: Current clinic kit (Welch Allyn DS / ADC Prosphyg class): navy nylon cuff, satin steel gauge, slightly worn cuff label.
summary: Handheld aneroid sphygmomanometer: 2.25 in chrome gauge with printed mmHg dial and needle, rolled nylon adult cuff, coiled tubing, rubber bulb with release valve.
